settings.heading: Build with ChatGPT & Claude.
settings.body:
Quadratum is designed to be understandable to people and connected AI assistants: named sections, reusable templates, native Shopify settings and a downloadable schema reference.

Our demos were built with ChatGPT and Claude in the workflow. Start with your brand and catalog, ask your assistant to use existing sections, then review its work in an unpublished theme.
